trip.title: Bier Reisen 2026
trip.subtitle: Franconia, Bohemia and the Alps
trip.route_line: Porto Alegre → Frankfurt → Merkendorf → Plzeň → České Budějovice → Bad Reichenhall → Berchtesgaden → Salzburg → Munich → Frankfurt → Porto Alegre

stops.name: Porto Alegre
stops.note: Departure, 25 February — overnight flight to Frankfurt.

stops.name: Frankfurt Airport
stops.note: Land on 26 February, collect the car, drive straight to Franconia.

stops.name: Merkendorf
stops.note: Three nights in the village of Brauerei Wagner, eight kilometres from Bamberg.

stops.name: Plzeň
stops.note: One night in the town that invented pilsner.

stops.name: České Budějovice
stops.note: Two nights for Budweiser Budvar — the tour plus a second day to drink it in.

stops.name: Bad Reichenhall
stops.note: Three nights in the Alps: Bürgerbräu, with Berchtesgaden and Salzburg an easy drive away.

stops.name: Berchtesgaden
stops.note: Day trip from Bad Reichenhall — 18 km, the Hofbrauhaus and the Watzmann.

stops.name: Salzburg
stops.note: Day trip across the border — 23 km, Augustiner Bräu Mülln and the old town.

stops.name: Munich
stops.note: Four nights: Andechs, Dachau, the Viktualienmarkt and the beer halls.

stops.name: Frankfurt Airport
stops.note: 11 March — 404 km from Munich, then the flight home.

days.title: Porto Alegre → Frankfurt
items: Overnight flight POA → FRA (10,665 km, ~13 h 30 in the air)
Dinner at the airport before boarding
The car is waiting in Frankfurt in the morning

days.title: Frankfurt → Merkendorf
items: 227 km / 2 h 22 east on the A3 and A70
Three nights in Merkendorf, the village of Brauerei Wagner
First evening at Wagner: the house beers, a few tables, no hurry

days.title: Merkendorf → Bamberg
items: Bamberg by day: Schlenkerla, Spezial, Mahr's, Fässla
The old town and the river, 11 km from the door
Back to Merkendorf for the night

days.title: Merkendorf — three breweries
items: Brauerei Wagner in Merkendorf
Drei Kronen in Memmelsdorf, 11 km away
The village Metzgerei-Brauerei — butcher, brewer and taproom in one

days.title: Merkendorf → Plzeň
items: 260 km / 2 h 38 east through the Upper Palatinate
One night in the town that invented pilsner
Na Spilce under the Prazdroj brewhouse

days.title: Plzeň → České Budějovice
items: 136 km / 2 h 11 south through Bohemia
Budweiser Budvar: the tour, the cellars and the tasting
Masné krámy for dinner on the square

days.title: České Budějovice — Budvar again
items: A second day at Budvar, or Samson in the centre
The Black Tower and the square, if the weather holds
Last Bohemian night

days.title: České Budějovice → Bad Reichenhall
items: 244 km / 2 h 57 west across the border into Bavaria
Three nights in Bad Reichenhall, 18 km from Berchtesgaden
Bürgerbräu in the evening, brewing here since 1494

days.title: Berchtesgaden and Salzburg
items: Berchtesgaden in the morning: Hofbrauhaus and the Watzmann
Salzburg across the border in the afternoon (23 km)
Brennerbräu on the way back

days.title: Bad Reichenhall, Berchtesgaden, Salzburg
items: A second Alpine day — Königssee or the Salzburg old town
Augustiner Bräu Mülln if you cross into Austria again
Last night in Bad Reichenhall

days.title: Bad Reichenhall → Munich
items: 135 km / 1 h 34 north-west on the A8
Four nights in Munich
Augustiner Bräustuben for the first Maß

days.title: Munich — Andechs
items: Kloster Andechs for the Doppelbock (45 km each way)
The Ammersee on the way back
Schneider Bräuhaus in the evening

days.title: Munich — Dachau and the Hofbräuhaus
items: Dachau: the memorial site, and the Dachauer Brauerei in town
Back to Munich for the Hofbräuhaus
A long evening in the Altstadt

days.title: Munich — Viktualienmarkt and the Residenz
items: Viktualienmarkt in the morning, the beer garden if it is open
The Residenz and the streets around it
Last night in Munich

days.title: Munich → Frankfurt → home
items: 404 km / 3 h 59 north on the A9 and A3
Return the car, check in at Frankfurt
Overnight flight FRA → POA (10,665 km)

days.title: Porto Alegre
items: Land in Porto Alegre on 12 March
16 days, 13 nights, two brewing countries and three Alpine days

Merkendorf.name: Brauerei Wagner
Merkendorf.note: Family brewery in Merkendorf since 1797, Pointstraße 1 — Franconian lagers poured in the brewery tap a few steps from the kettle.
Merkendorf.order: Wagner Lagerbier and the dark, in the tap with the regulars

Merkendorf.name: Drei Kronen, Memmelsdorf
Merkendorf.note: Brewery, Gasthof and hotel 11 km away; hand-brewed Franconian beer and a full menu.
Merkendorf.order: Drei Kronen Lagerbier, 11 km away in the next village

Merkendorf.name: Metzgerei-Brauerei, Merkendorf
Merkendorf.note: The village butcher who also brews — sausage, beer and a taproom in one building.
Merkendorf.order: The butcher's house beer, with the sausage that pays for it

Bamberg (day trip).name: Schlenkerla, Bamberg
Bamberg (day trip).note: 11 km to the Rauchbier cathedral: beechwood smoke, oak barrels, a vaulted cellar.
Bamberg (day trip).order: Aecht Schlenkerla Rauchbier Märzen, from the oak barrel

Bamberg (day trip).name: Spezial, Bamberg
Bamberg (day trip).note: The Bambergers' own rauchbier — softer smoke, shorter queue.
Bamberg (day trip).order: Spezial Rauchbier Lager — the local smoke

Bamberg (day trip).name: Mahr's Bräu, Bamberg
Bamberg (day trip).note: The 'aU' Ungespundetes, the reference Franconian lager.

Bamberg (day trip).name: Klosterbräu, Bamberg
Bamberg (day trip).note: Bamberg's oldest brewery, founded 1533 — the Schwärzla dark lager is the one to order, in a building with a 16th-century ballroom upstairs.
Bamberg (day trip).order: Schwärzla at Bamberg's oldest brewery, brewing since 1533

Plzeň.name: Pilsner Urquell (Prazdroj)
Plzeň.note: The brewery that defined pilsner in 1842; the tour ends with an unfiltered pour in the cellars.
Plzeň.order: The cellar pour — unfiltered, unpasteurised, straight from the barrel

Plzeň.name: Na Spilce
Plzeň.note: The brewery restaurant under the brewhouse — the freshest Prazdroj in town.

Plzeň.name: Purkmistr, Černice
Plzeň.note: Brewery, hotel and beer spa; book the bath if you want the full production.
Plzeň.order: Purkmistr Helles, with the beer spa if you booked

Plzeň.name: Gambrinus
Plzeň.note: The everyday Plzeň lager — lighter, cheaper, and just as local.
Plzeň.order: Gambrinus, the everyday lager of Plzeň

České Budějovice.name: Budweiser Budvar
České Budějovice.note: The other Budweiser: 70–80 minute tours through the brewhouse and the cellars, tasting at the end.
České Budějovice.order: Budvar Original from the tank, at the end of the 70-minute tour

České Budějovice.name: Budvar Samson
České Budějovice.note: The city brewery on the main square — dark and light, in a 19th-century building.

České Budějovice.name: Masné krámy
České Budějovice.note: The old meat market turned beer hall, Budvar by the metre.
České Budějovice.order: Budvar by the metre in the old meat market

Bad Reichenhall.name: Bürgerbräu Bad Reichenhall
Bad Reichenhall.note: Private Alpine brewery since 1494, Waaggasse 1–3 — the town's own beer, with a Brauereigasthof.
Bad Reichenhall.order: Bürgerbräu Hell in the Brauereigasthof, brewing since 1494

Bad Reichenhall.name: Brennerbräu
Bad Reichenhall.note: Gasthof between Bad Reichenhall and Berchtesgaden — the stop on the way back from Salzburg.
Bad Reichenhall.order: The house beer on the road back from Salzburg

Bad Reichenhall.name: Hofbrauhaus Berchtesgaden
Bad Reichenhall.note: 18 km away: the valley's own brewery and restaurant, Helles and Dunkel.

Bad Reichenhall.name: Augustiner Bräu Mülln, Salzburg
Bad Reichenhall.note: 23 km across the border: the Mülln monastery brewery, beer from the wooden barrel, bring your own food.
Bad Reichenhall.order: Müllner Bräu by the litre, with cheese and radishes from your bag

Bad Reichenhall.name: Stiegl, Salzburg
Bad Reichenhall.note: Austria's largest private brewery, with a brewery tour and a museum in the city.
Bad Reichenhall.order: Stiegl Goldbräu, in the brewery's own cellar

Munich.name: Kloster Andechs
Munich.note: Benedictine monastery brewery above the Ammersee (45 km) — Doppelbock Dunkel and a terrace over the valley.

Munich.name: Dachauer Brauerei
Munich.note: 20 km out: the town's craft brewery, a short walk from the station and the memorial site.
Munich.order: The Dachau house Helles, after the memorial

Munich.name: Hofbräuhaus
Munich.note: The room everyone has heard of — go early, stay for the brass band.

Munich.name: Viktualienmarkt
Munich.note: Market beer garden in the centre, with a rotating brewery tap under the Maibaum.

Munich.name: Augustiner Bräustuben
Munich.note: The Augustiner brewery tap on Landsberger Straße: Edelstoff from the wooden barrel.
Munich.order: Edelstoff and the meatloaf, at the long table

Munich.name: Augustiner Keller
Munich.note: Chestnut beer garden and winter room, still pouring from wooden barrels.

Munich.name: Schneider Bräuhaus
Munich.note: Wheat-beer house on Tal: Aventinus and the original Tap 7.

Munich.name: Die Residenz
Munich.note: The Wittelsbach palace — the day's walk ends here, with the beer halls of the Altstadt a few minutes away.
Munich.order: No beer here — walk to the Hofbräuhaus afterwards

Merkendorf.subnote: The village of Brauerei Wagner, eight kilometres from Bamberg.

Bamberg (day trip).subnote: Eleven kilometres from Merkendorf, and the densest brewery town in Franconia.

Plzeň.subnote: One night in the town that invented pilsner.

České Budějovice.subnote: Two nights at Budvar, so the tour is not the only thing you do.

Bad Reichenhall.subnote: Bürgerbräu since 1494, with Berchtesgaden 18 km and Salzburg 23 km away.
Bad Reichenhall.famous: Alpine brewery beer and Salzburg's beer halls

Munich.subnote: Four nights, with Andechs and Dachau as day trips.
Munich.famous: Helles, Weißbier and the beer halls
